tasks.name: maintenance-routing
tasks.design: Existing 12 finite holdout fixtures, baseline and local model, three repetitions per profile
tasks.primary: Expected terminal classification and verified effects; zero unauthorized effects and false success

tasks.name: inbox-sorting
tasks.design: Development batch of six notes for integration; separate fixed holdout of twelve notes in three batches of four, three repetitions per profile
tasks.primary: Exact action/reference/uncertain labels per note, quote groundedness, schema validity

runtime: Pinned model-artifacts.lock.json; one model at a time, 4096 context, single sequence, temperature zero, thinking disabled
latency: Retain every request including failures; separate first request from subsequent requests; report medians and nearest-rank p95 with sample size, not throughput or universal hardware minimums
scope: These are controlled synthetic tasks with real inference and actual disposable file effects. They do not establish quality on private reader notes or safety for arbitrary shell execution.
tuning: Freeze prompts and fixture hashes before holdout. If integration requires changes, version the plan and retain earlier development results. Do not tune on holdout.
release: Publish sanitized requests, responses, predictions, fixed labels, timings, hashes and a deterministic verifier; no private paths or weights. Report failures as results.
